taskTitle: Design a GM-R degenerated differential amplifier
circuit:
* GM-R source-degenerated differential amplifier (Sky130), gain = 2 V/V.
* Core: NMOS-LVT diff pair, ideal-R bridge degeneration RDEG (no DC drop),
* mirrored 290uA tails. Each load branch: two diode-connected LVT devices in
* series with ideal RL. The two diode Vgs shifts reproduce the pair Vgs shift
* at every current split, so vod/vid is set by resistor ratios (gain trim via
* RL vs RDEG is linear-only). Wide diodes (3x800um) preserve output headroom.
* Residual third-order distortion is cancelled by a small cross-connected
* tanh pair (XA1/XA2); its bias is a mirror tail minus a Vth-sensing current
* (XINJ/RINJ/XDX -> P-mirror), so the cancellation tracks slow/fast N corners.
* XCLP clamps the aux tail node so the aux bulk junctions can never forward
* bias when the injected current exceeds the mirror tail (fast-N corners).
.subckt gmr_degen IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS
XMB  IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=20 nf=4
XMTA TA   IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=116 nf=29
XMTB TB   IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=116 nf=29
XM1 VON VIP TA TA sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=1000 nf=200
XM2 VOP VIN TB TB sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=1000 nf=200
RDEG TA TB 605
RD1 VDD VDIV 32k
RD2 VDIV VSS 148k
XINJ VDD VDIV YINJ VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
RINJ YINJ XDN 16.5k
XDX XDN XDN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XPI1 PIN PIN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
XPI2 TX PIN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
XPIS PIN XDN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
* aux cross tanh pair, tail = mirror minus Vth-sensing injection
XA1 VOP VIP TX TX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=20 nf=4
XA2 VON VIN TX TX sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=20 nf=4
XMTX TX IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4.1 nf=1
XCLP TX TX VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
* load chains
XD1A VDD VDD N1A N1A sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=800 nf=160 m=3
XD2A N1A N1A N2A N2A sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=800 nf=160 m=3
RLA  N2A VON 707
XD1B VDD VDD N1B N1B sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=800 nf=160 m=3
XD2B N1B N1B N2B N2B sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=800 nf=160 m=3
RLB  N2B VOP 707

taskTitle: Design a GM-R degenerated differential amplifier
circuit:
* GM-R degenerated differential amplifier, Sky130, target gain = 2.00 V/V
* Architecture: regulated-shunt current conveyor (gm-boosted degenerated GM stage).
*  - RIN converts (VIN-0.9V) to current at virtual-ground node X held at VCM by
*    a 5T error amp driving shunt NMOS M2 (gm-boosted source degeneration).
*  - Wide-swing cascoded NMOS mirror (ratio k=5/2) conveys the signal current
*    into ideal load resistor RL returned to VCM. Gain = k*RL/RIN.
*  - Output CM is pinned to VCM through RL; all bias currents mirrored from IREF.
* Sizes in micrometres (sky130 scale=1u).

.subckt gmr_degen IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS

* IREF pin receives 50uA from the bench (VDD -> IREF); sink with NMOS diode.
XMNB  IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12 nf=2

XMNS  PB   IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4.8 nf=1

XMNR  NCB  NCB  MID VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.35 w=1.4 nf=1
RBZ   MID  VSS 50k

* ---------------- side A : VIN -> VOP ----------------
RINA  VIN XA 1729
XMPXA XA  PB  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=2 w=13 nf=2 m=6
* error amp: forces XA = VCM
XMTA  TA  IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=15 nf=3
XMA1A LA  XA  TA  VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=2

taskTitle: Design a GM-R degenerated differential amplifier
circuit:
* GM-R degenerated differential amplifier -- Sky130, 1.8 V, 27 C
*
* Topology
*   LVT NMOS differential pair (XM1/XM2) with an ideal degeneration resistor RS
*   tied directly between the two sources, and one long-channel tail sink per
*   source (XMT1/XMT2) so no DC current flows in RS.  Cascodes (XMC1/XMC2)
*   drive the ideal load resistors RLN/RLP.  The differential gain is
*
*       Av = RL / ( RS/2*(1 + gmb/gm) + 1/gm + ... )  ~= 2 V/V
*
*   Because the tail current is copied from the ideal 50 uA IREF, gm is nearly
*   process independent, the resistors are exact, and the residual 1/gm term is
*   only ~11 % of the denominator; the 1 MHz gain therefore stays inside
*   +-0.25 % over tt/ff/ss/fs/sf.  The pair uses L = 0.7 um and the tail sinks
*   L = 4 um: both output conductances sit in the gain expression, while the
*   pair's gate charge sets the (frequency-proportional) HD3 floor, so those
*   lengths balance gain spread against large-signal SDR.
*
* Bandwidth
*   The output pole RL*(1 pF + Cd) sits near 30 MHz on its own.  XCS across RS
*   adds a zero at 1/(2*pi*RS*CS) that lands on that pole, so the response is
*   flat to ~235 MHz (second pole at f_zero/alpha).  MIM capacitance is corner
*   independent in this PDK (all five sections use the nominal cap parameters).
*
* Biasing
*   The bench forces 50 uA into IREF.  XMB1/XMB2 form a stacked diode pair:
*   node NB = Vgs biases the 3.5x tail mirrors (175 uA per branch), and the
*   IREF node itself = 2*Vgs biases the cascode gates, placing the pair's drains
*   near 0.62 V with >0.17 V of saturation margin in every corner.  Total
*   external DC power is 0.71 mW.  VCM is not needed: the output common mode is
*   set by RL and the mirrored tail current, so no common-mode feedback loop is
*   required.
*
* Simulated signoff (tt/ff/ss/fs/sf, VDD = 1.8 V, 27 C, 1 pF loads)
*   gain @1 MHz  1.9952 .. 2.0044 V/V      (limit 1.98 .. 2.02)
*   -3 dB BW     231 .. 240 MHz            (limit > 70 MHz)
*   DC power     0.706 .. 0.709 mW         (limit < 1.2 mW)
*   SDR @3 MHz   72.1 .. 84.5 dB           (limit > 60 dB)
*   SDR gain     1.9949 .. 2.0060 V/V      (limit 1.90 .. 2.10)
*
* Sky130 MOS syntax (dimensions in micrometres):
* XN d g s b sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=10 nf=1 m=1

.subckt gmr_degen IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS

* ---- bias reference: 50 uA in at IREF; NB = Vgs, IREF node = 2*Vgs
XMB1 IREF IREF NB  VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=33 nf=7 m=1
XMB2 NB   NB   VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=132 nf=27 m=1

* ---- tail sinks: 3.5 x 50 uA = 175 uA per branch
XMT1 S1 NB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=462 nf=94 m=1
XMT2 S2 NB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=462 nf=94 m=1

* ---- input pair
XM1 D1 VIP S1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=210 nf=35 m=1
XM2 D2 VIN S2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.7 w=210 nf=35 m=1

* ---- cascodes shield the pair from the output swing
XMC1 VON IREF D1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=12 m=1
XMC2 VOP IREF D2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=60 nf=12 m=1

* ---- degeneration with bandwidth-extension zero
RS  S1 S2 3989
XCS S1 S2 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=25.5 l=25.5

* ---- load resistors
RLN VDD VON 5123
RLP VDD VOP 5123

.ends gmr_degen

taskTitle: Design a GM-R degenerated differential amplifier
circuit:
* GM-R degenerated differential amplifier (Sky130)  --  gain 2 V/V
*
* Architecture
* ------------
* Two identical single-ended telescopic-cascode transconductors, each closed
* in an inverting (shunt-shunt) resistive feedback loop:
*
*   VIN --R1-- vxp --R2-- VOP        VIP --R1-- vxn --R2-- VON
*
* so v(VOP)-v(VON) = (R2/R1)*(v(VIP)-v(VIN)).  The gain is a ratio of ideal
* resistors and is therefore process-corner immune; the only corner-dependent
* term is the finite-loop-gain error
*
*   eps = (1 + R2/R1) / ( Gm * (R2 || Ro) )   ~ 1.2 %
*
* which is absorbed by the R1 trim (60.73k) and whose corner spread is only
* +-0.13 %.  Design choices that shrink eps and its spread: large R1/R2 (the
* output load is then dominated by the ideal R2 rather than by the corner-
* varying Ro), long cascodes (L=1.0/0.8 um) to raise Ro to ~1 MOhm, and a
* short-L PMOS mirror (L=0.25 um) so the mirror pole stays well above the
* ~110 MHz loop crossover (this removes the AC peaking).
*
* Why not an open-loop degenerated pair: with a 1 pF load the >70 MHz corner
* forces an output resistance below ~2 kOhm, and holding R_L/(R_S + 2/gm)
* inside +-1 % over corners would then need gm*R_S > 100, i.e. tens of mS of
* transconductance - far outside the 1.2 mW budget.  Closing the loop puts
* the gain on the resistor ratio instead of on gm.
*
* Common mode: the non-inverting input of each transconductor is tied to VCM,
* so the summing node is servoed to 0.9 V by the same high-gain loop.  With no
* DC current in R1/R2 the outputs settle on VCM as well (measured 0.898..0.902
* V over corners), so no separate CMFB loop - and no CMFB stability problem -
* is needed.  VCM, VIN and VIP see gates and balanced resistor ends only, so
* they draw no DC current.
*
* Bias: the 50 uA IREF diode feeds 4:1 NMOS tail mirrors (2 x ~180 uA) plus
* three 12.5 uA branches; ideal resistors RNB/RPB place the cascode replicas
* 0.42 V above VSS and 0.40 V below VDD, so the cascode bias tracks Vgs over
* corners.  Worst-case |Vds|-|Vdsat| over the five corners is 89 mV.
*
* MIM caps across R1/R2 (ratio C1/CF = R2/R1) form a compensated attenuator:
* the feedback factor and the closed-loop gain both stay flat despite the
* ~80 fF of input capacitance on the summing node.
*
* Measured (tt/ff/ss/fs/sf, 1.8 V, 27 C, 1 pF loads):
*   gain @1 MHz 1.9974..2.0026 V/V | BW 144..205 MHz
*   external power 0.790..0.807 mW | SDR 95.5..98.5 dB (fund. 2.000..2.005)
*
* Sky130 MOS syntax: X<name> d g s b <model> l=<um> w=<um> nf=<n>

.subckt gmr_degen IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS

*---------------------------------------------------------------- bias chain
* 50 uA IREF diode: NMOS mirror reference for the two 4:1 tails (~180 uA).
XMB1 IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=30 nf=10
* 12.5 uA branch generating the PMOS mirror reference nvbp.
XMB2 nvbp IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7.5 nf=3
XMB3 nvbp nvbp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=25 nf=5
* NMOS cascode gate bias: 1/12 replica of XM2A standing on 0.42 V.
XMB4 nvbnc nvbp VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=25 nf=5
XMB5 nvbnc nvbnc n42 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.0 w=15 nf=3
RNB n42 VSS 33.6k
* PMOS cascode gate bias: 1/12 replica of XM3A standing 0.40 V below VDD.
XMB6 nvbpc IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=7.5 nf=3
XMB7 nvbpc nvbpc p40 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.8 w=20 nf=5
RPB VDD p40 32k

*--------- transconductor P (-> VOP): 3:1 asymmetric pair, signal on vxp,
*--------- VCM reference on XM1BP; cascoded 3:1 PMOS mirror load.

XM1BP ndbp VCM  nsp VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=33 nf=11

*--------- transconductor N (-> VON): identical copy, signal on vxn.

taskTitle: Design a GM-R degenerated differential amplifier
circuit:
* ===================================================================
* GM-R source-degenerated differential amplifier -- Sky130
*
*   .subckt gmr_degen IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS
*
* Target: Avd = 2.00 V/V, f-3dB > 70 MHz into 1 pF/side,
*         P(ext) < 1.2 mW, SDR > 60 dB @ 3 MHz / 100 mVpk diff.
*
* --------------------------- topology ------------------------------
* Classic GM-R transconductor: an NMOS differential pair whose sources
* are tied together through a floating degeneration resistor RDEG, with
* ideal load resistors RLP/RLN to VDD.  The differential gain is
*
*       Avd = 2*RL / ( RDEG + 2/gm )                                (1)
*
* so it is set by a resistor ratio.  Ideal resistors carry no process
* corner dependence at all, so every remaining corner sensitivity comes
* from the small 2/gm term and from device output conductances.  Three
* design choices remove those:
*
* 1) Input-pair bulks are tied to their own sources (deep-nwell NMOS).
*    With a bulk at VSS the degeneration is stiffened by gmb, i.e. RDEG
*    is multiplied by (1+gmb/gm) in (1); that ratio drifts ~10% over
*    corners.  Tying b=s removes the term entirely.
*
* 2) The tail current sources are cascoded.  An uncascoded tail sits at
*    only ~0.36 V of Vds, right at the saturation knee, where ro is both
*    low (~40..70k) and strongly corner dependent.  That ro shunts
*    RDEG/2 (~1.5k) and was by far the largest gain error.  The cascode
*    lifts the tail output resistance into the multi-megohm range.
*
* 3) The input devices use L = 1 um.  Their gds appears in (1) as a
*    gds*(RL+RDEG/2) loss term weighted by ~2.8*gds/gm; doubling L
*    halves it and cuts the residual corner spread to <0.2%.
*
* Bandwidth: the load pole is 1/(2*pi*RL*Ctot) ~= 45 MHz, too low on its
* own.  XCDEG across RDEG puts a zero at 1/(2*pi*RDEG*CDEG) right on top
* of that pole; the degeneration network's own pole then sits a factor
* RL/(2/gm) ~= 8x higher, extending f-3dB to ~200 MHz with a flat, non
* peaking response.  MIM capacitance is identical in all five FET
* corners (they all use parameters_cap_nom), so the cancellation holds.
*
* Biasing: the 50 uA forced into IREF flows through RB into the diode
* connected reference XMREF, so V(NB) = Vgs,ref biases the tail devices
* and V(IREF) = V(NB) + 50u*RB biases the tail cascodes.  Because both
* rails ride on the same Vgs, the cascode source voltage T1/T2 (~0.175
* V) tracks Vth and stays ~58 mV above the tail Vdsat in every corner.
*
* Output common mode = VDD - Itail*RL ~= 0.96 V.  It is set by a
* mirrored current through an ideal resistor and therefore needs no
* common-mode feedback; the VCM reference pin is left unloaded, which
* also keeps its contribution to the measured external power at zero.
*
* Element policy: only official Sky130 PDK subcircuits (nfet_01v8,
* nfet_01v8_lvt, cap_mim_m3_1) plus finite positive ideal resistors.
* ===================================================================

.subckt gmr_degen IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS

* ---- bias: 50 uA from IREF -> RB -> diode reference -> VSS ---------
* NB    = tail gate            (~0.66 V)
* IREF  = tail-cascode gate    (NB + 50u*RB, ~0.88 V)
RB    IREF NB 4400
XMREF NB   NB   VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=58  nf=9

* ---- cascoded tail current sources, 300/58 = 5.17x -> ~242 uA -----
XMTB1 T1 NB   VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=300 nf=44
XMTB2 T2 NB   VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=300 nf=44
XMTC1 S1 IREF T1  VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=200 nf=30
XMTC2 S2 IREF T2  VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=200 nf=30

* ---- input pair, bulk = own source (no gmb in the degeneration) ---
XM1   VON VIP S1 S1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=400 nf=58
XM2   VOP VIN S2 S2 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=400 nf=58

* ---- degeneration: R sets the gain, C extends the bandwidth -------
RDEG  S1 S2 2928
XCDEG S1 S2 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=24.579 l=24.579

* ---- loads --------------------------------------------------------
RLP   VDD VOP 3455
RLN   VDD VON 3455

.ends gmr_degen

taskTitle: Design a GM-R degenerated differential amplifier
circuit:
* GM-R differential amplifier with source degeneration (Sky130).
*
* Each half is a V-I converter: a local two-stage op-amp drives the gate of a
* native NMOS so its source (S) follows the input exactly. The degeneration
* resistor RS between the two sources then carries (VIP-VIN)/RS, and since the
* follower's gate draws no current, that current flows straight out of its
* drain into the load RL. Hence Adiff = 2*RL/RS, set by a resistor ratio and
* only reduced by the ~64 dB local loop gain (RL is trimmed 0.05% to cancel).
* The follower drain sees only RL||1 pF, so BW ~ 1/(2*pi*RL*CL).
* Bias: every current is mirrored from the 50 uA IREF; VCM is not needed.

* Two-stage Miller op-amp: out drives the follower gate so inn tracks inp.
.subckt gmr_opamp inp inn out bn vdd vss
XA1 o1 inp ct vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=16 nf=2
XA2 da inn ct vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=16 nf=2
XA3 da da vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XA4 o1 da vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XA5 ct bn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1 m=2
XA6 out o1 vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2 m=4
XA7 out bn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1 m=4
* ~76 fF Miller capacitor with lead-zero resistor.
XCC o1 cz sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=6 l=6
RZ cz out 5k
.ends gmr_opamp

* One half: op-amp + native follower (low VGS keeps the op-amp output near
* mid-rail) + cascoded 120 uA tail.
.subckt gmr_half vin s d bn bc vdd vss
XOP vin s g bn vdd vss gmr_opamp
XM1 d g s vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_03v3_nvt l=0.5 w=20 nf=2
XT1 s bc ts vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1 m=12
XT0 ts bn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1 m=12
.ends gmr_half

.subckt gmr_degen IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS
* Wide-swing cascode bias from the 50 uA reference (10 uA per unit device).
RCB IREF bn 6k
XBC bn IREF bb VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1 m=5
XBD bb bn VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=8 nf=1 m=5

XHP VIP SP VON bn IREF VDD VSS gmr_half
XHN VIN SN VOP bn IREF VDD VSS gmr_half
RS SP SN 1.6k
RLP VDD VON 1.6008k
RLN VDD VOP 1.6008k
.ends gmr_degen

* offset, and a cascoded PMOS second stage provides high loop gain.
* Cc/Rz Miller compensation and the Cf feedback zero set the phase
* margin; ideal resistors set the precise closed-loop gain.

* GM-R degenerated differential amplifier
* Telescopic-cascode OTA with resistive differential feedback.
* Gain is set by the Rf/Ri ratio; the input pair is degenerated by the
* feedback network and by the current-mode (high-impedance) output.

.subckt gmr_degen IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS
* --- bias reference: 50 uA in, NMOS diode + PMOS diode ---
XNB   IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=4 w=200 nf=8
XNB2  PB   IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8     l=4 w=200 nf=8
XPB   PB   PB   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4 w=84  nf=4

* --- tail current source: 8x IREF = 400 uA (two devices in parallel) ---
XNT1  TAIL IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=800 nf=8
XNT2  TAIL IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=4 w=800 nf=8

* --- PMOS cascode current-source loads: 4x IREF = 200 uA each ---
XPLP  P1   PB   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4   w=326 nf=4
XPLN  P2   PB   VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=4   w=326 nf=4
XPCN  VOP  VCP  P1  VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=300 nf=4
XPCP  VON  VCP  P2  VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=300 nf=4

* --- NMOS input pair and cascodes ---
XNIN  D1   S1   TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=4
XNIP  D2   S2   TAIL VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.15 w=80 nf=4
XNCN  VOP  VCN  D1   VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5  w=60 nf=2

* --- differential resistive feedback ---
R1    VIP  S1   20k
R2    VOP  S1   41.2k

R4    VON  S2   41.2k

* --- cascode gate bias from VDD/VSS dividers ---
R5    VDD  VCN  180k
R6    VCN  VSS  320k
R7    VDD  VCP  230k
R8    VCP  VSS  200k
XCB1  VCN  VSS  sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=50 l=50 mult=1
XCB2  VCP  VSS  sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=50 l=50 mult=1

taskTitle: Design a GM-R degenerated differential amplifier
circuit:
* GM-R differential amplifier with source degeneration.
* Single-stage fully differential telescopic OTA:
*   - degenerated NMOS GM input pair
*   - cascoded NMOS + PMOS current-source loads (high loop gain)
*   - active common-mode feedback referenced to VCM
*   - resistive feedback sets closed-loop differential gain ~ 2
* Dimensions in micrometres (SKY130 scale=1u).

* ---- 50 uA reference diode and input tail mirror ----
XMREF  iref iref VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1 m=1
XMTAIL tail iref VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=1 m=8

* ---- degenerated GM input pair ----
RS1 s1 tail 50
RS2 s2 tail 50
XM1 n1 g1 s1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.2 w=133 nf=1 m=1
XM2 n2 g2 s2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.2 w=133 nf=1 m=1

XMC1 von vbnc n1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1.5 w=100 nf=1 m=1

RBNB vbnc vss 78k
XCB1 vbnc vss sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=20 l=25 mult=1

RBPB vbpc vss 28k
XCB2 vbpc vdd sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=20 l=25 mult=1

* moderate CM shunt to the 0.9 V reference stiffens the output CM

taskTitle: Design a GM-R degenerated differential amplifier
circuit:
* GM-R degenerated differential amplifier (Sky130, 1.8V)
* Two identical two-stage Miller op-amps in resistive-feedback
* (inverting) configuration give a differential gain of exactly
* Rf/Rg = 2 with output common-mode set to VCM.
*
* Top-level pin order (required):
*   IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Single-ended two-stage Miller op-amp.
*   PLUS  : non-inverting input  (VOUT = +A * (PLUS - MINUS))
*   MINUS : inverting input
*   VOUT  : output
*   VBN   : NMOS tail-current mirror gate (from IREF diode)
*   VDD, VSS : supplies
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt opamp PLUS MINUS VOUT VBN VDD VSS
* Stage 1: NMOS (LVT) differential pair, PMOS (LVT) mirror load.
XM1 n1 MINUS tail VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=12 nf=4
XM2 n2 PLUS  tail VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=12 nf=4
XMT tail VBN  VSS  VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=8  nf=2
XM3 n1 n1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=18 nf=4
XM4 n2 n1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=18 nf=4
* Stage 2: common-source NMOS with PMOS current-source load.
XM6 VOUT n2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=30 nf=6
XM7 VOUT n1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5  w=36 nf=6
* Miller compensation (MIM, ~0.25 pF).
XCC n2 VOUT sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=11 l=11
.ends opamp

* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* Top-level amplifier.
* ---------------------------------------------------------------------
.subckt gmr_degen IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS
* Bias reference: diode-connected NMOS sinks the 50 uA IREF.
XMREF IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=4 nf=1

* Inverting amplifier for the VIP -> VOP side.
XAMPA VCM na VOP IREF VDD VSS opamp
* Inverting amplifier for the VIN -> VON side.
XAMPB VCM nb VON IREF VDD VSS opamp

* Resistive feedback network: nominal gain magnitude Rf/Rg, trimmed
* slightly above 2 to compensate the finite loop gain (3/A ~ 0.6%).
RGA VIP na 25k
RFA VOP na 50.32k
RGB VIN nb 25k
RFB VON nb 50.32k
.ends gmr_degen

XMREF IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2

* pbias: NMOS sink into diode LVT PMOS

XMPREF pbias pbias VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10 nf=2

XMSRC nbnc pbias VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=7 nf=1
XMRNC nbnc nbnc VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=0.6 nf=1

* nbpc: PMOS-cascode bias (NMOS sink into diode regular PMOS)
XMSNP nbpc IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1
XMBPC nbpc nbpc VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=4 nf=1

XPC1 VOP nbpc n1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=24 nf=6
XPC2 VON nbpc n2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=24 nf=6

XN1 VOP nbnc nc1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=2 w=20 nf=4

RCM1 VOP cms 1meg
RCM2 VON cms 1meg
* Reduced-current CMFB OTA (lower gm -> smaller compensation requirement)

taskTitle: Design a GM-R degenerated differential amplifier
circuit:
* GM-R degenerated differential amplifier (Sky130).
* Differential in/out, source-degenerated NMOS pair, resistor loads, cascoded.
* Half-circuit gain A = RD/(1/gm + Rdeg/2); ideal R's make the ratio
* corner-stable.  Degeneration loop alpha = gm*Rdeg/2 ~ 4 suppresses HD3.
* The pair is cascoded: its ro and drain caps are isolated from the 1 pF
* load, so the output pole is set by RD*CL.  Cascode gates are biased at
* ~1.1 V by a small resistor-fed 2-diode NMOS string (low AC impedance).
* Signal NMOS bulks tie to their own source (isolated wells): no body effect.
.subckt gmr_degen IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS
* --- Input differential pair (parallel units stay within bin width) ---
XN1A  n1 VIP sn sn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=700 nf=10
XN1B  n1 VIP sn sn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=700 nf=10
XN2A  n2 VIN sp sp sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=700 nf=10
XN2B  n2 VIN sp sp sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=700 nf=10
* --- Cascode devices (gate at VBC~1.1V, bulk tied to own source) ---
XNC1  VOP VBC n1 n1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=350 nf=5
XNC2  VON VBC n2 n2 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=350 nf=5
* --- Cascode gate bias: resistor-fed 2-diode NMOS string (~1.1 V) ---
RBIAS VDD VBC 55k
XNB1  VBC VBC vb1 vb1 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=3 nf=1
XNB2  vb1 vb1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=3 nf=1
* --- Source degeneration resistor between the two source nodes ---
RDEG  sn sp 1.7k
* --- Resistor loads ---
RDLP  VDD VOP 2.04k
RDLN  VDD VON 2.04k
* --- Tail current sources mirrored from IREF: 50 uA -> ~250 uA each ---
XNT1  sn IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=200 nf=8
XNT2  sp IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=200 nf=8
* --- Diode reference device carrying the external 50 uA IREF ---
XNRF  IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=40 nf=4
.ends gmr_degen

taskTitle: Design a GM-R degenerated differential amplifier
circuit:
* GM-R degenerated differential amplifier, Sky130.
* Fully-differential telescopic-cascode OTA with resistive feedback
* (closed-loop gain Rf/Rin = 2 V/V) plus a capacitive feedback divider
* (Cin/Cf ~= 2) across it: at signal frequencies the input pair's gate
* charge is supplied directly by the low-impedance input source, so the
* large high-gm input devices add no summing-node pole. A slow, heavily
* compensated continuous-time CMFB amplifier holds the output CM at VCM.
* Pins: IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS

.subckt gmr_degen IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS

* ---- Feedback network (inverting, same-side feedback) ----
Rinp VIP gp 60k
Rinn VIN gn 60k
Rfp  VOP gp 120k
Rfn  VON gn 120k
* Capacitive divider across the feedback (Cin/Cf ~= Rf/Rin = 2, MIM);
* sets the high-frequency closed-loop gain near 2 and supplies gate charge
Xcinp VIP gp sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=22 l=22 mf=1
Xcinn VIN gn sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=22 l=22 mf=1
Xcfp  gp VOP sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=15 l=15 mf=1
Xcfn  gn VON sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=15 l=15 mf=1

* ---- Bias generation from IREF (50 uA into IREF node) ----
* NMOS diode reference -> vbn = IREF
Xmr0  IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10 nf=1
* PMOS diode -> y1 = VDD - Vsg ; resistor drops one overdrive -> y2
Xmrp1  y1  y1  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=20 nf=1
Rbp    y1  y2  8.6k
Xmrn   y2  IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=10 nf=1
* NMOS cascode-bias branch: ~15 uA PMOS source -> n3, resistor + diode NMOS to VSS
Xmpc   n3  y1  VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=6 nf=1
Rbn    n3  k   40k
Xmnd   k   k   VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=4 nf=1

* ---- Main telescopic cascode amplifier (NMOS input) ----
* Tail ~400 uA
Xm0    t   IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=80 nf=4

circuit:
* GM-R source-degenerated differential amplifier (Sky130, 1.8 V core devices)
*
* Topology
* --------
* An NMOS differential pair M1/M2 with source-degeneration resistors RS1/RS2
* and resistive loads RL1/RL2 to VDD.  The tail current is mirrored from the
* 50 uA IREF reference, so the pair bias is set by a current mirror rather
* than by a resistor.  The gain
*
*       A = gm*RL / (1 + gm*RS)
*
* is consequently fixed by the mirrored current and the RL/RS ratio, both of
* which are process-stable, giving a tight 1 MHz gain across all corners.
*
* Design notes
* ------------
*  - Input device bulks are tied to their own sources, so the body-effect
*    term gmb does not enter the gain denominator.
*  - The tail device is made wide (W/L = 1000) so that it remains well into
*    saturation at the elevated source node and the mirror ratio holds.
*  - The pair runs at a large V_ov together with a large quiescent drop
*    across the load (I_D*RL ~ 0.54 V).  Third-order distortion of a
*    degenerated pair scales as HD3 ~ Vd^2 / (32*(I_D*RL)^2), so this drop
*    is what sets the large-signal dynamic range for the 100 mV-peak
*    differential 3 MHz test.
*  - The input device width is kept small to hold down the drain parasitic
*    capacitance, which together with the external 1 pF load sets the
*    -3 dB bandwidth.  Quiescent current is held below the 1.2 mW budget.

circuit:
* Differential-in, differential-out amplifier with exact gain of 2 V/V.
*
* Architecture: two identical single-ended feedback amplifiers, one per
* polarity (VIP -> VOP, VIN -> VON).  Each is a two-stage Miller amplifier
* whose closed-loop gain is 1 + RF/RG, fixed by the ratio of two ideal
* resistors.  The loop gain at 1 MHz holds the closed-loop magnitude within
* a fraction of a percent of 2 in every corner, and the two halves are
* driven in antiphase so even-order distortion cancels in the differential
* output.
*
* Node roles inside gmr_amp:
*   INP  - signal input (0.9 V common mode)     OUT - amplifier output
*   FB   - feedback divider node (also inverting input of stage 1)
*   NT   - input-pair tail node                  NB - reference gate bias
*   NA   - PMOS mirror diode node
*   NB1  - stage-1 output / stage-2 gate / Miller node
*   NG   - Miller capacitor tap (nulling resistor side)

.subckt gmr_degen IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS
* 50 uA reference diode; every tail current mirrors from it.
XDI IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=25 nf=1
* One amplifier per polarity.
XAP VIP VOP VDD VSS IREF VCM gmr_amp
XAN VIN VON VDD VSS IREF VCM gmr_amp
.ends gmr_degen

.subckt gmr_amp INP OUT VDD VSS NB VCM
* Stage 1: NMOS input pair with PMOS mirror load.  The pair is exactly
* symmetric, so the systematic input offset (and with it the output common
* mode) stays near zero in every corner.
XM1 NA  FB NT VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20  nf=1
XM2 NB1 INP NT VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20  nf=1

XP2 NB1 NA VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8   nf=1
XMNT NT NB VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1   w=30  nf=1
* Stage 2: NMOS common-source transconductor with resistor load (GM-R).
* The loop holds OUT at 0.9 V, so the stage current is exactly
* 0.9 V / RL in every corner; the load needs no bias node at all.
XM3 OUT NG VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=100 nf=1

* resistive feedback divider referenced to VCM:

* ratio sets the gain; source degeneration linearises the pair.

* XM1 is the inverting path (gate=VIN) and XM2 the non-inverting path
* (gate=VNM), so the two-stage chain is non-inverting overall.

XM2 VD2 VNM  VST2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=2 w=32 nf=4

RS2 VST2 VT 200

XMT VT VBT VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=1 w=4 nf=1
* PMOS current-mirror load (stage-1 output is VD1)

XM4 VD1  VD2 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=32 nf=4

* Sky130 source-degenerated differential GM-R amplifier.
* NMOS diff pair with resistive source degeneration and resistive loads.

* current ratio is set by resistor ratios; the pair uses long channels so
* the load-dominated gain stays corner-stable. A MIM capacitor bypasses

* low. Dimensions in micrometres.

.subckt gmr_degen IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS

* Bias: degenerated K:1 mirror of IREF. Equal source-resistor drops keep
* the reference and tail at matched current density, so Itail ~ K*IREF.
XMREF IREF IREF rref VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
RREF rref VSS 2250
XMTAIL t2 IREF rtail VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=180 nf=36
RTAIL rtail VSS 250

XM2 VOP VIN sn t2 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=200 nf=40

RSN sn t2 610

RDP VDD VOP 1960
RDN VDD VON 1960

* Tail bypass: low-impedance shunt at 2x the signal frequency suppresses
* the second-harmonic tail voltage that mixes into third-order distortion.
* In this PDK the nominal capacitance is set by geometry only (the wrapper
* mult does not scale it): 2 fF/um^2 * (w+0.15)*(l+0.15) ~ 20 pF each.

taskTitle: Design a GM-R degenerated differential amplifier
circuit:
* gmr_degen: differential-input, differential-output GM-R amplifier
* with source degeneration.
*
* Single-stage fully differential telescopic-cascode GM-R core:
*   source-degenerated NMOS input pair (GM-R), NMOS cascodes, PMOS
*   cascoded output current sources regulated by a common-mode feedback
*   amplifier that pins the output CM to VCM.
* Ideal-R cross feedback sets the closed-loop differential gain to
*   R2/R1 = 2.00 V/V, from the resistor ratio alone.
*
* The input pair is short and narrow so Cgs at the summing node stays
* tiny; that keeps the summing-node pole far above the closed-loop
* bandwidth set by gm_eff/(2*pi*C_L)/3.  The PMOS cascode raises Rout
* so A stays high with modest R2.
*
* Pin order: IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS

.subckt gm_core VDD VSS VBIASN VBIASP VBIASC INN INP VCM VON VOP
* --- Source-degenerated NMOS differential pair (GM-R) ---
* Tail 400 uA (8x IREF); 200 uA per side.  Small W/L keeps Cgs low.
XM0 tail VBIASN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XM1 n1 INN s1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
RS1 s1 tail 5
XM2 n2 INP s2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=10 nf=1
RS2 s2 tail 5

* --- NMOS cascodes (200 uA each, same as the pair) ---
* Wide cascode shields XM1 Cgd (kills the Miller term at the summing
* node) while its own Cdb sits at the output.
XM5 VON VBIASC n1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=120 nf=12
XM6 VOP VBIASC n2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=120 nf=12

* --- PMOS cascoded output current sources, 200 uA each ---
* Short, moderate-W cascode keeps Cgs at the p1/p2 nodes small so the
* cascode source pole stays well above the signal band.
XM7  p1  cmb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
XM7c VON VBIASP p1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4
XM8  p2  cmb VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=200 nf=20
XM8c VOP VBIASP p2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=4

* --- Common-mode feedback: sense (VOP+VON)/2 vs VCM, drive cmb ---
* Averaging with resistors keeps the CMFB from reacting to the
* differential signal, which would otherwise eat bandwidth.
* RCL loads the output CM to VCM (no DC current) so the CMFB output
* pole sits well above its unity-gain frequency; RCB damps cmb.
RCM1 VOP vav 1meg
RCM2 VON vav 1meg
RCL1 VOP VCM 50k
RCL2 VON VCM 50k
XM9  cma vav  scm VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XM10 cmb VCM  scm VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XM11 scm VBIASN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XM12 cma cma VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XM13 cmb cma VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XCB cmb cmb VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
.ends gm_core

.subckt gmr_degen IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS
* --- Bias string: IREF is the 50 uA source into this pin ---
XMD IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XMB nbias IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=1
XPB nbias nbias VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8

* --- NMOS cascode gate bias: PMOS current into diode + resistor stack ---
XPB2 ncas nbias VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
RCAS ncas ncasd 14k
XMD2 ncasd ncasd VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.5 w=40 nf=8

* --- PMOS cascode gate bias: PMOS current into resistor to VSS ---
* vbcp = 50uA * 4k = 0.2 V, well below |Vtp| so the cascode is on.
XPB3 vbcp nbias VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=40 nf=8
RCP vbcp VSS 4k

* --- Symmetric cross feedback (ideal R) ---
* VOP feeds INP and VON feeds INN so the loop is negative; with
* R2/R1 slightly above 2 the finite open-loop gain lands the closed
* loop at exactly 2.00 V/V.
R1P VIP inn 125k
R2P VOP inp 258k
R1N VIN inp 125k
R2N VON inn 258k

* --- Differential GM-R core ---
XGM VDD VSS IREF vbcp ncas inn inp VCM VON VOP gm_core
.ends gmr_degen

* Architecture: two independent single-ended inverting feedback amplifiers.
*   Amp A: VON = -(Rf/Rin)*(VIN - VCM) ; Amp B: VOP = -(Rf/Rin)*(VIP - VCM)

* Dimensions in micrometres (PDK sets scale=1u). Ideal R allowed; caps use MIM.

* ---------- Local two-stage Miller op-amp ----------
* Pins: P N O VDD VSS VBN VBP   (non-inv, inv, out, supplies, nm/pmos bias)
.subckt gmr_opamp P N O VDD VSS VBN VBP
* Stage 1: NMOS diff pair with source degeneration, PMOS current-mirror load
XMT  t1  VBN VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=3
RS1  n1  t1 60
RS2  n2  t1 60
XM1  a  N n1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XM2  s1 P n2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=8 nf=2
XM3  a  a VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=3
XM4  s1 a VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=12 nf=3

XM6  O  VBP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=24 nf=4

RZ   O  mz 700
XCC  mz s1 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=16 l=16 mult=1

* ---------- Top level ----------
.subckt gmr_degen IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS

XBIASN  IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=4 nf=2

RINA VIN xa 10k
RFA  VON xa 20k
XAMPA VCM xa VON VDD VSS IREF pb gmr_opamp
* Amp B : drives VOP from VIP
RINB VIP xb 10k
RFB  VOP xb 20k
XAMPB VCM xb VOP VDD VSS IREF pb gmr_opamp

taskTitle: Design a GM-R degenerated differential amplifier
circuit:
* gmr_degen: differential-input, differential-output GM-R amplifier.
* Two-stage fully-differential OTA. Stage 1: source-degenerated NMOS pair
* with resistive loads from VDD; the stage-1 output common mode is
* A1 = VDD - (Itail/2)*RLOAD, set by the corner-stable tail mirror, so no
* first-stage CMFB is needed. Stage 2: NMOS common-source devices gated at
* A1 (~0.9 V); PMOS loads are gated by the output CMFB. The tail mirror is
* ground-referenced (diode and output device share source/body at VSS) so
* the 100 uA tail current tracks the NMOS IREF reference over corners.
* Ideal-resistor feedback sets differential gain to RF/RG = 2.013, trimmed
* so finite loop gain lands the closed-loop gain just under 2. Miller
* compensation uses PDK MIM capacitors with zero-nulling resistors; Cgd
* neutralization capacitors keep the feedback divider bandwidth high.

.subckt gmr_degen IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS

* ---- Feedback network: gain = RF/RG = 30.2k/15k = 2.013 (trimmed so the
* finite-loop-gain error lands the closed-loop gain just under 2.00) ----
RG1 VIP INP 15k
RF1 VON INP 30.2k
RG2 VIN INN 15k
RF2 VOP INN 30.2k

* ---- Bias core from IREF (50 uA pushed from VDD into IREF) ----
* NMOS diode reference: the IREF node is the NMOS gate-bias rail.
XMB1 IREF IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=25 nf=5
* PMOS bias branch (25 uA): defines the PMOS gate-bias rail VPBIAS.
XMBN VPBIAS IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=12.5 nf=2
XMBP VDD VPBIAS VPBIAS VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=40 nf=8

* ---- Stage 1: source-degenerated NMOS differential pair ----
XM1 A1 INN S1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=16
XM2 A2 INP S2 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=80 nf=16
RDEG1 S1 TAIL 22
RDEG2 S2 TAIL 22
* Resistive loads fix the stage-1 output CM: A1 = VDD - 18k*(Itail/2) ~ 0.9V
RLOAD1 VDD A1 18k
RLOAD2 VDD A2 18k

* ---- Tail current mirror, ground-referenced ----
* 6.25 uA PMOS source pushes the diode XMTD (source at VSS, so its overdrive
* exactly matches XMTAIL's). Ratio 16x -> Itail = 100 uA; the low diode
* overdrive keeps XMTAIL saturated with TAIL near 0.35 V.
XMPRS VDD VPBIAS VGT VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=10 nf=2
XMTD VGT VGT VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=35 nf=5
XMTAIL TAIL VGT VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=560 nf=80

* ---- Stage 2: NMOS common-source, PMOS loads gated by the CMFB ----
XM5 VON A1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=13 nf=2
XM6 VOP A2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=13 nf=2
XM7 VDD CMOUT VON VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=320 nf=64
XM8 VDD CMOUT VOP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=1 w=320 nf=64

* ---- Miller compensation with zero-nulling resistors ----
RZ1 A1 Z1 1.2k
RZ2 A2 Z2 1.2k
XCC1 Z1 VON sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=13.99 l=13.99
XCC2 Z2 VOP sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=13.99 l=13.99

* ---- Cgd neutralization across the differential pair ----
XCN1 INN A2 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=3 l=3
XCN2 INP A1 sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=3 l=3

* ---- Output CMFB: resistive output-CM sense vs VCM ----
RCM1 VOP CMS 100k
RCM2 VON CMS 100k
XMCT SCT IREF VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=1 w=10 nf=2
XMC1 CMN1 CMS SCT VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XMC2 CMOUT VCM SCT VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=5 nf=1
XMCP1 CMN1 CMN1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XMCP2 CMOUT CMN1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l=0.5 w=20 nf=4
XCCM CMOUT VSS sky130_fd_pr__cap_mim_m3_1 w=141.3 l=141.3

.ends gmr_degen

taskTitle: Design a GM-R degenerated differential amplifier
circuit:
* Sky130 GM-R degenerated differential amplifier.
* Differential input (VIP, VIN) -> differential output (VOP, VON).
*
* Two-stage fully-differential closed-loop amplifier, gain ~ Rf/Rg = 2.
*   VIP --- Rg --- Va,    VOP --- Rf --- Va
*   VIN --- Rg --- Vb,    VON --- Rf --- Vb
* Stage 1 is a small NMOS differential pair -> NMOS cascodes -> cascoded PMOS
* mirror loads, giving high (unloaded) gain at internal nodes v1p/v1n.
* Stage 2 is a pair of source followers that buffer the output: an NMOS
* follower level-shifts v1 down ~one VGS, then a PMOS follower drives the
* output, so the 1 pF caps and feedback network do not load the high-
* resistance stage-1 node.  MIM caps set the dominant pole.
* All bias currents derive from IREF.

.subckt gmr_degen IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS

* ---- bias reference: NMOS diode sinks the 50 uA IREF ----
XM0 iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4.2 nf=1 m=1

* ---- PMOS cascode reference stack (50 uA, sink XM8 mirrors XM0) ----
XM7a nA nA vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=8.4 nf=2 m=1
XM7b nB nB nA vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=8.4 nf=2 m=1
XM8  nB iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4.2 nf=1 m=1

* ---- NMOS cascode bias stack (50 uA through two stacked NMOS diodes) ----
XMpc nC nA vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4.2 nf=1 m=1
XM9a nC nC nL vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4.2 nf=1 m=1
XM9b nL nL vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4.2 nf=1 m=1

* ---- tail current source: 200 uA (4x the 50 uA reference) ----
XM5 t iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16.8 nf=4 m=1

* ---- stage-1 input differential pair (small, low Cgs) ----
XM1 d1 va t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=32 nf=8 m=1
XM2 d2 vb t vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.15 w=32 nf=8 m=1

* ---- stage-1 NMOS cascodes (internal outputs v1p/v1n) ----
XM1c v1p nC d1 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16.8 nf=4 m=1
XM2c v1n nC d2 vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16.8 nf=4 m=1

* ---- stage-1 cascoded PMOS mirror loads (100 uA per side) ----
XM3  y3 nA vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16.8 nf=4 m=1
XM3c v1p nB y3 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=33.6 nf=8 m=1
XM4  y4 nA vdd vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16.8 nf=4 m=1
XM4c v1n nB y4 vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=33.6 nf=8 m=1

* ---- stage-2: NMOS level-shift follower + PMOS output follower ----
XN1f VDD v1p gp gp sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16.8 nf=4 m=1
XN2f VDD v1n gn gn sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16.8 nf=4 m=1
XN1b gp iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4.2 nf=1 m=1
XN2b gn iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=4.2 nf=1 m=1
XP1  vss gp vop vop sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8_lvt l=0.35 w=16.8 nf=4 m=1

taskTitle: Design a GM-R degenerated differential amplifier
circuit:
* Sky130 GM-R degenerated differential amplifier
* pFET differential input pair, gates are the feedback summing nodes.
* The pair runs in subthreshold (gate CM 0.9 V vs pFET vth ~0.95 exceeds the
* 1.8 V supply headroom), so gm is set by width; a wide pair gives enough
* transconductance for the loop gain required to pin closed-loop gain at
* R2/R1 = 2.0.  Ideal corner-stable resistors set the closed-loop gain.
* nFET current-source loads (gates on the resistive common-mode network)
* provide open-loop gain; a resistor from VDD sets the tail current.
*
* Terminal order: IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS
.subckt gmr_degen IREF VCM VDD VIN VIP VON VOP VSS
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Bias diode on the external IREF node (50 uA forced from VDD).
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XBIR iref iref vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=2 l=0.5 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Tail: resistor from VDD to the pFET pair source node.  With input CM
* fixed by the bench at 0.9 V this sets the pair current; subthreshold
* current scales with pair width.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
RPT vdd pt 20

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* pFET differential input pair, gates are the summing nodes.
* XP1: inp -> VOP leg     XP2: inm -> VON leg
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
XP1 vop inp pt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=700 l=0.5 nf=100
XP2 von inm pt vdd sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=700 l=0.5 nf=100

* nFET current-source loads, gates on the resistive common-mode node.
* vgn is the resistor-weighted average of the outputs, so the loads
* conduct in strong inversion at the output common mode.
XN3 vop vgn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=15 l=2 nf=1
XN4 von vgn vss vss sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=15 l=2 nf=1

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Resistive common-mode feedback: vgn = (vop+von)/2 drives the loads.
* Output CM up -> loads sink more -> outputs down (negative).
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
RCM1 vop vgn 50k
RCM2 von vgn 50k

* ------------------------------------------------------------------
* Feedback: VIN --R1--> M2 gate <--R2-- VON   (negative loop)
*           VIP --R1--> M1 gate <--R2-- VOP   (negative loop)
* Differential gain = R2/R1 = 100k/50k = 2.0 (corner-stable ideal R).
* Large R keeps the network from shunting the high-gain output node.
* ------------------------------------------------------------------
R1A vip inp 50k
R1B vin inm 50k
R2A vop inp 100k
R2B von inm 100k

.ends gmr_degen
